Habitat V0.4.3

Changelog

  • Improved: Notch Nook now auto switches media controls to active media if multiple sources are playing and one is then paused.
  • Fixed: Window recording Habitat app would sometimes fail.
  • Fixed: Mic input no longer shows when recording if no mic is selected.
  • Fixed: Trackpad toggles sometimes showing as disabled even though they weren’t.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
